# Synthetic example data

**Everything in this folder is SYNTHETIC.** It was generated by `make_synthetic.py` (deterministic, seed 0) from
hand-designed keyframes. It contains no real recording, no real calibration and no real robot log.

| file | content |
|---|---|
| `synthetic_bimanual_demo.csv` / `.npz` | 30 s, 30 Hz bimanual "pick two corners and half-fold" jaw-tip trajectory with jaw open/close, ~1.5 mm / ~1° measurement noise and marker dropouts (around grasps, a few random short ones, and one 2 s dropout on the left hand that should *not* be filled) |
| `synthetic_robot_replay.csv` | a simulated replay: the noise-free motion passed through `scripts/robotize.py`, delayed by 0.25 s, scaled by 0.97 about the start, with ~2 mm tracking noise |
| `make_synthetic.py` | the generator |

Scenario features that exercise the tools: the right hand briefly reaches across the body midline (robotization
compresses it), and both jaw tips dip slightly below the table plane while grasping (soft table floor).

## Format

One row per frame, `t` in seconds, then per hand (`R_` right, `L_` left):

| column | unit | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `x, y, z` | m | jaw-tip position in the world (robot base) frame: +x forward, +y left, +z up; table plane z = 0 |
| `qx, qy, qz, qw` | – | jaw-tip orientation, unit quaternion |
| `jaw` | – | 1 = open, 0 = closed |
| `visible` | – | 1 = pose measured (markers seen), 0 = not measured (pose is NaN) |

The tools append columns such as `filled` (0 measured / 1 interpolated / 2 unfilled), `human_x/y/z`, `disp_mm` and
`quality` (0/1/2).

## Run

```bash
python examples/make_synthetic.py
python scripts/gap_fill.py examples/synthetic_bimanual_demo.csv out/filled.csv
python scripts/robotize.py out/filled.csv out/robotized.csv
python scripts/parity_metrics.py out/robotized.csv examples/synthetic_robot_replay.csv
python scripts/plot_example.py out/robotized.csv out/example.png --robot examples/synthetic_robot_replay.csv
```
